findings.title: Plan discovery reads symlinked plan JSON outside the workspace
findings.source: agent source review + real confirmation dispatcher probe
findings.applicability: Requires an attacker-controlled plans directory or .json symlink and a readable valid plan-shaped JSON outside the selected workspace. Disclosure proved for title, plan id, status and revision; arbitrary non-JSON file disclosure was not proved.
findings.flow: plan_list -> _load_plans -> glob/read_text follows symlink without containment validation -> _PlanState.from_raw -> model-visible title
findings.observation: Both a file symlink and a plans-directory symlink returned a synthetic outside plan title. Write containment controls kept the outside JSON unchanged.
findings.resolution: Unfixed. Apply workspace containment and regular-file checks to discovery/reads, including directory and file symlinks; retain the existing write-side guard.
